name: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking products and services to cooperatives in Indonesia. The company offers saving, demand deposit, time deposit, and current accounts. It also provides consumer, syndicated, joint financing, and channeling loans; financing, and banking services. The company operates through a network of branches, sub-branches, and functional offices, as well as ATMs.It has operations in Jakarta, Bogor, Tangerang, Bekasi, Java, Sumatera, Kalimantan, and internationally.
